findings.evidence: The description excludes 'reviewing existing C4 diagrams without regenerating them' but does not mention repairing a broken C4 diagram or translating one for an unsupported renderer, both workflows covered by the skill and its evals.
findings.fix: Generate and repair architecture documentation as C4 model Mermaid diagrams: context, container, component, dynamic and deployment views. Use when users ask to map or document a software system, its deployable applications, data stores, external actors, request flows or production infrastructure from a description or repository evidence such as Docker Compose and Kubernetes manifests, even without naming C4. Also use to fix broken C4 diagrams or translate them for a renderer without C4 support. Not for ER diagrams, ordinary flowcharts or sequence diagrams, draw.io or cloud-icon diagrams, C4 theory without a diagram, review-only requests, implementation work, or ADR prose.

findings.evidence: The workflow requires 'Every relationship ... with a verb and a technology' while line 39 requires the technology to be evidenced and the sparse-input branch permits modeling only user-stated facts.
